description: This file defines a GUI dialog class 'ExclusionMatrix' for managing a behaviors exclusion matrix in the BORIS software. It includes UI setup, button handlers for selecting/deselecting behaviors, and logic for checking/unchecking behavior exclusions.

classes.name: ExclusionMatrix
classes.description: A dialog for managing a behaviors exclusion matrix, allowing users to check/uncheck mutually exclusive behaviors.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the exclusion matrix dialog, sets up UI components and layout.

methods.name: pb_selected
methods.description: Checks or unchecks the selected cells in the exclusion matrix based on the 'to_check' boolean.

methods.name: pb_cb_selection
methods.description: Selects, unselects, or reverts the check state of all cells in the matrix based on 'mode'.

methods.name: cb_clicked
methods.description: Synchronizes checkbox states between behavior pairs in the matrix.
